title: 只要……就 in Chinese: How to Say "As Long As" (HSK 3 Grammar)
description: How to use 只要……就 (zhǐyào... jiù) for "as long as" in Chinese: word order, where 就 goes, 只要 vs 只有……才, common mistakes and HSK 3 examples.
h1: How to Say "As Long As" with 只要……就
lede: 只要 (zhǐyào) means "as long as" or "all you need is". It gives a condition that is enough on its own, and 就 (jiù) in the second part gives the result.

paras: 只要 can go before or after the subject of the first part: 只要你努力 and 你只要努力 are both fine. The condition comes first. 就 goes before the verb in the second part, after its subject if it has one.

examples.zh: 只要你努力，就能学好汉语。
examples.py: Zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì, jiù néng xuéhǎo Hànyǔ.
examples.en: As long as you work hard, you'll learn Chinese well.

examples.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就去公园。
examples.py: Zhǐyào bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qù gōngyuán.
examples.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go to the park.

examples.zh: 你只要多练习，就会说得很好。
examples.py: Nǐ zhǐyào duō liànxí, jiù huì shuō de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: As long as you practise a lot, you'll speak it well.

paras: 只要 often says that the condition is easy: just do this one thing and the result will follow. It can also describe a habit, where it is close to "whenever".

examples.zh: 只要你打个电话，他就会来。
examples.py: Zhǐyào nǐ dǎ ge diànhuà, tā jiù huì lái.
examples.en: All you have to do is call, and he'll come.

examples.py: Zhǐyào nǐ xǐhuan, jiù mǎi ba.
examples.en: If you like it, just buy it.

examples.zh: 只要有时间，我就去跑步。
examples.py: Zhǐyào yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù pǎobù.
examples.en: Whenever I have time, I go running.

examples.zh: 只要你不说，他就不会知道。
examples.py: Zhǐyào nǐ bù shuō, tā jiù bú huì zhīdào.
examples.en: As long as you don't tell him, he won't find out.

sections.h2: 只要……就 vs 只有……才
paras: 只有 (zhǐyǒu) looks similar but means "only if": the condition is the one thing that must happen, and nothing else will do. It goes with 才, not 就. 只要 goes with 就, not 才.
Mixing the two pairs is the most common mistake. 只要你努力，才能学好 and 只有你去，我就去 are both wrong.

examples.zh: 只有多练习，才能说好汉语。
examples.py: Zhǐyǒu duō liànxí, cái néng shuōhǎo Hànyǔ.
examples.en: Only by practising a lot can you speak Chinese well.

examples.py: Zhǐyǒu nǐ lái, wǒ cái qù.
examples.en: I'll only go if you come.

worksheet.title: 只要……就 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 只要……就 worksheet for HSK 3: 17 exercises (只要 or 只有, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 只要 or 只有
exercises.instructions: Write 只要 or 只有 in each gap. Look at 就 or 才 in the second part.

items.en: As long as you come, I'll be happy.
You can only watch TV once you've finished your homework.
As long as the weather is nice, we'll go hiking.

items.zh: ＿＿每天复习，你才能记住这些字。
items.en: Only if you revise every day will you remember these characters.
Whenever she isn't busy, she goes to see her mum.
We can only go if he agrees.

items.zh: ＿＿你说得慢一点儿，我就能听懂。
items.en: As long as you speak a bit more slowly, I can understand.
He only has time at the weekend.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: As long as you want to go, go.
As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go.
Whenever I have time, I read.
As long as you take it seriously, you'll do well in the exam.
We can only start once he's here.
answers: 只有他来了，我们才能开始。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.zh: 只要你认真学，才能学好。
items.en: As long as you study carefully, you'll learn it well.
answers: 只要你认真学，就能学好。

items.en: As long as the weather is nice, we'll go.
He's only at home on Sundays.

items.zh: 只要明天不忙，我去就看你。
items.en: As long as I'm not busy tomorrow, I'll come and see you.
answers: 只要明天不忙，我就去看你。
